'''EaseMyTrip''' is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[online travel agency|online travel company]], headquartered in [[New Delhi]]. It was founded in 2008 by [[Nishant Pitti]], Rikant Pitti, and Prashant Pitti. The company provides [[Online hotel reservations|hotel bookings]], [[air ticket]]s, [[Package tour|domestic and international holiday package]]s, bus bookings, and white-label services.

== History ==
[[File:EaseMyTrip Homescreen Screenshot.jpeg|thumb|Homescreen of the EaseMyTrip mobile app]]
The idea for EaseMyTrip came when the brothers, Nishant Pitti and Rikant Pitti used to book air tickets for their father's frequent business trips, and saved money in the booking process. Initially based out of their home garage as a travel agency, the duo lost all of the initial [[Capital expenditure|investment]] within the first three months.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/aggressive-easemytrip-flies-into-top-league-117011101422_1.html|title=Aggressive EaseMyTrip flies into top league|last=Modi|first=Ajay|date=2017-01-12|work=Business Standard India|access-date=2019-06-03}}</ref> Later on, references from family and friends helped and a major turnaround came when an airline noticed multiple bookings coming from a single email account and contacted the Pitti brothers to become its travel partner.<ref>{{Cite web|title=EaseMyTrip faces cash flow issues as forward bookings drop, refunds continue|url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/aviation/easemytrip-faces-cash-flow-issues-as-forward-bookings-drop-refunds-continue-5837421.htm|access-date=2020-10-09|website=cnbctv18.com|language=en-US}}</ref>

In 2019, EaseMyTrip had a network of more than 42,000 [[Travel agency|travel agents]], 1,200 franchise outlets, 640 white-label solutions, and around 1,600 distributors.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/easemytrip-looks-to-raise-up-to-rs-750cr-via-ipo-books-axis-capital-jm-financial-as-bankers-3937471.html|title=EaseMyTrip looks to raise up to Rs 750cr via IPO; books Axis Capital, JM Financial as bankers|website=Moneycontrol|access-date=2019-06-03}}</ref>

In 2019, EaseMyTrip expanded its operations to international markets such as [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]], [[United Kingdom|UK]], [[United States|US]], [[Philippines]], [[Singapore]], and [[Thailand]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=EaseMyTrip's Q2 profit jumps by 330% YOY; air segment, hotel bookings rise|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/corporate/story/easemytrips-q2-profit-jumps-by-330-yoy-air-segment-hotel-bookings-rise-311256-2021-11-03|access-date=2021-11-25|website=Business Today|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Kundu|first=Rhik|date=2021-11-02|title=EaseMyTrip net profit surges over 300% to ₹27.13 crore|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/company-results/easemytrip-reports-over-300-increase-in-net-profit-to-27-13-crore-during-sept-quarter-11635860866095.html|access-date=2021-11-25|website=mint|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|last=Chaturvedi|first=Anumeha|title=EaseMyTrip expands international presence to Philippines, Thailand, and the USA|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/travel/easemytrip-expands-international-presence-to-philippines-thailand-and-the-usa/articleshow/86254468.cms|access-date=2021-11-25}}</ref>

In March 2021, EaseMyTrip went public with an [[initial public offering]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|last=Chengappa|first=Sangeetha|title=EaseMyTrip clocks 47% CAGR from FY 2018-20|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/easemytrip-clocks-47-cagr-from-fy-2018-20/article34481873.ece|access-date=2021-09-15|website=@businessline|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Kundu|first=Rhik|date=2021-06-15|title=EaseMyTrip reports eight-fold increase in Q4 profit|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/company-results/easemytrip-reports-eight-fold-increase-in-q4-profit-11623767955551.html|access-date=2021-09-15|website=mint|language=en}}</ref> It became the first online travel agency to be listed on the [[National Stock Exchange of India|Indian stock exchanges]].<ref>{{Cite news|last=www.ETtech.com|title=EaseMyTrip plans to raise Rs 700 crore from public issue – ETtech|url=https://tech.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/internet/easemytrip-plans-to-raise-rs-700-crore-from-public-issue/72465986|access-date=2019-12-11|newspaper=The Economic Times|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|date=2019-12-11|title=EaseMyTrip's IPO Plans May Go Live Soon To Raise INR 700 Cr|url=https://inc42.com/buzz/easemytrips-ipo-plans-may-go-live-soon-to-raise-inr-700-cr|access-date=2019-12-11|website=Inc42 Media|language=en-US}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=EaseMyTrip IPO is set to open on Monday — price band for the issue set at ₹186 to ₹187 per share|url=https://www.businessinsider.in/stock-market/news/easemytrip-ipo-is-set-to-open-on-march-8-in-india-checkout-everything-you-need-to-know/articleshow/81308938.cms|access-date=2021-03-03|website=Business Insider}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|title=Easy Trip Planners IPO subscribed over 159 times on last day|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/ipos/fpos/easy-trip-ipo-to-close-today-subscribed-nearly-8-times-so-far/articleshow/81425248.cms|access-date=2021-03-16}}</ref>

In June 2021, EaseMyTrip collaborated with [[Oyo Rooms]], [[Airbnb]], and [[Yatra (company)|Yatra]] to form the [[Confederation of Hospitality, Technology and Tourism Industry]] (CHATT), an industry body for the [[tourism]] sector of India.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Oyo, Airbnb, EaseMyTrip, Yatra join hands; form industry body for tourism sector|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/economy-politics/story/oyo-airbnb-easemytrip-yatra-join-hands-form-industry-body-for-tourism-sector-297706-2021-06-09|access-date=2021-09-15|website=Business Today|language=en}}</ref>

In September 2021, it became a unicorn after its market capitalisation crossed $1 billion.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Chakraborty|first=Chiranjivi|title=Travel portal Ease My Trip joins India's burgeoning unicorn list. Is it a good time to lap up the stock?|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/travel-portal-ease-my-trip-joins-indias-burgeoning-unicorn-list-is-it-a-good-time-to-lap-up-the-stock/articleshow/86291678.cms|access-date=2021-09-25}}</ref> In December 2021, the organisation hired [[Vijay Raaz]] and [[Varun Sharma]] as their brand ambassadors.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Livemint |date=2021-12-29 |title=EaseMyTrip appoints Vijay Raaz and Varun Sharma as brand ambassadors |url=https://www.livemint.com/industry/advertising/easemytrip-appoints-vijay-raaz-and-varun-sharma-as-brand-ambassadors-11640770638910.html |access-date=2022-07-14 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref>

EaseMyTrip acquired Spree Hospitality, a hospital management company established in 2011 by Keshab Baljee, for an undisclosed amount.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Chaturvedi|first=Anumeha|title=EaseMyTrip acquires Spree Hospitality, a 1200 keys hospitality management company|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/hotels-/-restaurants/easemytrip-acquires-spree-hospitality-a-1200-keys-hospitality-management-company/articleshow/87778312.cms|access-date=2021-11-25}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|last=Chaturvedi|first=Anumeha|title=EaseMyTrip acquires Spree Hospitality, a 1200 keys hospitality management company|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/hotels-/-restaurants/easemytrip-acquires-spree-hospitality-a-1200-keys-hospitality-management-company/articleshow/87778312.cms|access-date=2021-12-13}}</ref> The company announced the acquisition of travel marketplace Traviate in October 2021.<ref>{{Cite news|title=EaseMyTrip to buy travel marketplace Traviate in first ever acquisition|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/easemytrip-to-acquire-travel-marketplace-traviate-in-first-ever-acquisition/articleshow/87333879.cms|access-date=2021-11-25}}</ref> EaseMyTrip acquired Yolobus, an intercity mobility platform, in 2021.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Chaturvedi |first=Anumeha |title=EaseMyTrip acquires the YoloBus brand to expand its non-air business |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/easemytrip-acquires-the-yolobus-brand-to-expand-its-non-air-business/articleshow/88315228.cms |access-date=2022-07-14}}</ref>

In August 2024, the platform signed on [[Jacqueline Fernandez]] as a brand ambassador.<ref>{{Cite news |title=EaseMyTrip.com appoints Bollywood actress Jacqueline Fernandez as brand ambassador |work=BusinessStandard |url=https://www.business-standard.com/markets/capital-market-news/easemytrip-com-appoints-bollywood-actress-jacqueline-fernandez-as-brand-ambassador-124082300410_1.html |access-date=2022-08-24}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Jacqueline Fernandez joins EaseMyTrip as brand ambassador |work=BrandEquity.com |url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/marketing/jacqueline-fernandez-joins-easemytrip-as-brand-ambassador/112739221 |access-date=2022-08-24}}</ref>

On 17 September 2024, it announced its move into the [[medical tourism]] sector with the acquisition of a 49 per cent [[Equity (finance)|equity stake]] in Pflege Home Healthcare for [[Indian rupee|₹]]30 [[crore]], and a 30 per cent stake in Rollins International for ₹60 crore.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Manchanada |first=Kunal |date=2024-09-17 |title=EaseMyTrip invests Rs 90 Cr in two overseas firms; enters medical tourism space |url=https://entrackr.com/2024/09/easemytrip-invests-rs-90-cr-in-two-overseas-firms-enters-medical-tourism-space/ |access-date=2024-09-17 |website=Entrackr |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=EaseMyTrip enters medical tourism; board approves Rs 90 crore acquisitions |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/easemytrip-enters-medical-tourism-board-approves-rs-90-crore-acquisitions-124091700578_1.html}}</ref>

In November 2024, EaseMyTrip acquired a 49% stake in Planet Education Australia. This move will expand its presence in international study tourism.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/services/travel/easemytrip-to-acquire-planet-education-australia-foray-into-study-tourism/articleshow/115340164.cms?from=mdr/ |title=EaseMyTrip to acquire Planet Education Australia, foray into study tourism |work=The Economic Times |access-date=15 November 2024}}</ref>

==Controversies==
On March 8, 2022,{{when|date=September 2023}} a consumer technology firm from [[Pune]] called udChalo filed a trademark infringement case against EaseMyTrip.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/business-of-brands/udchalo-files-infringement-case-against-easymytrip-and-other-online-travel-agents-in-delhi-hc/90072572|title = UdChalo files infringement case against EasyMyTrip and other online travel agents in Delhi HC - ET BrandEquity}}</ref> Previously, [[MakeMyTrip]] also moved to [[Delhi High Court]] against the company and [[Google]] both for [[Trademark]] violation.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.businesstoday.in/latest/story/makemytrip-files-suit-against-easemytrip-over-trademark-violation-182339-2019-03-22|title = MakeMyTrip files suit against EaseMyTrip over trademark violation| date=22 March 2019 }}</ref>
